tools.name: dropcontact_get_credits
tools.description: Return the credits left on the Dropcontact account. Free for you: it does not use credits. Dropcontact API: GET /v1/account/credits.

tools.name: dropcontact_submit_enrichment
tools.description: Start B2B enrichment for 1 to 250 contacts: finds and verifies professional emails, LinkedIn and company data. tools.description: Fetch the enriched records for a request_id from dropcontact_submit_enrichment. tools.name: dropcontact_get_webhook
tools.description: Return the default webhook URL that Dropcontact calls when an enrichment result is ready (null when none is set). Dropcontact API: GET /v1/enrich/webhook.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: dropcontact_submit_enrichment, dropcontact_get_webhook · Private data: dropcontact_submit_enrichment, dropcontact_get_enrichment_result · Public sink: dropcontact_submit_enrichment, dropcontact_get_webhook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: dropcontact_submit_enrichment, dropcontact_get_webhook · Private data: dropcontact_submit_enrichment, dropcontact_get_enrichment_result · Public sink: dropcontact_submit_enrichment, dropcontact_get_webhook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
